Create a premium editorial perfume campaign photograph for "Special Spicy (RPA)".

PRODUCT RULES:

Preserve: exact bottle design, shape, proportions, cap, label, material, overall product identity.
Must not be covered: true.
Must not be distorted: true.

SCENE:
Bodegón de perfumería nicho sobre piedra mineral oscura: la botella vertical y estable ocupa el centro de una composición rica de bergamota, higo, rosa, azafrán, oud y patchouli, con una lectura clara de luz cítrica hacia profundidad amaderada.

ENVIRONMENT:
Una losa de piedra caliza gris carbón con vetas cálidas sostiene la botella completamente vertical. A la derecha se agrupan higos maduros, hojas y rosas; a la izquierda aparecen bergamotas cortadas y un pequeño recipiente de azafrán. Fragmentos de oud se extienden horizontalmente hacia el fondo, conectados por patchouli en capas.

VISUAL ELEMENTS:
botella exacta plenamente visible y vertical, losa de piedra caliza oscura, grupo de bergamotas enteras y cortadas, higos enteros y partidos, hojas y flores de patchouli, rosas naturales en tonos rosa empolvado, hebras y flores de azafrán, fragmentos de madera de oud, sutil atmósfera mineral ámbar

VISUAL IDENTITY:
La cámara de las especias: una arquitectura sensorial de oud oscuro, hojas de patchouli, higo aterciopelado, rosa envejecida y destellos de azafrán, atravesada por la luz fresca de la bergamota.

MOOD:
cálido, sensual, misterioso, lujoso, botánico, sofisticado, envolvente

PALETTE:
charcoal stone, deep olive green, muted bergamot green-gold, fig violet, dusty rose, saffron red-gold, dark oud brown, soft amber

MATERIALS:
dark limestone, resinous oud wood, textured citrus rind, velvety fig skin and granular pulp, matte patchouli leaves, natural rose petals, fine saffron threads, subtle mineral haze

LIGHTING:
large soft key light from upper left, narrow warm rim from rear right and gentle frontal fill preserving label readability.
Contrast: moderately high, with luminous citrus and bottle highlights against deep wood and mineral shadows.

TYPOGRAPHY:
Use the following campaign-specific information in the negative space:
"SPECIAL SPICY (RPA) | Intensidad que deja huella | Perfume nicho unisex especiado | NOTAS DE SALIDA · bergamota | NOTAS DE CORAZÓN · higo y rosa | NOTAS DE FONDO · azafrán, oud y patchouli"

FIXED CAMPAIGN RULES:
- The bottle is physically supported by a realistic surface.
- The bottle is completely vertical and stable; it never floats or tilts.
- Use clear foreground, midground and background depth.
- Create richness through quantity, grouping, overlap, layers and texture, not oversized ingredients.
- Keep generous negative space for Spanish typography.
- Typography must never cover the bottle and must remain legible.
- The bottle has the highest visual priority.

CAMPAIGN CONTINUITY:
Both images must share: same perfume identity, same olfactive story, same core visual elements, same color family, same emotional atmosphere.

PHYSICAL SCALE:
Use the perfume bottle as the physical scale reference for the entire scene.
Bottle dimensions: 19 cm high x 3.5 cm wide x 3.5 cm deep.
Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
Do not create abundance by artificially enlarging ingredients.

CAMERA:
50mm lens, medium shallow depth of field, focus on the perfume bottle, horizontal composition, 5:4 aspect ratio.

PHOTOREALISM:
extreme photorealism. photorealistic materials, realistic lighting, realistic shadows, realistic reflections, realistic glass, realistic botanical textures, realistic physical proportions, realistic atmospheric effects, no illustration, no cartoon, no obvious CGI, no generic stock photography.

DO NOT INCLUDE:
no people, no hands, no extra perfume bottles, no extra products, no distorted bottle, no duplicated bottle, no malformed bottle, no covered bottle, no oversized ingredients, no giant fruits, no giant flowers, no unrealistic ingredient proportions, no ingredient clutter.

immersive_surreal.prompt:
Create a premium cinematic surreal perfume campaign photograph for "Special Spicy (RPA)".

MAIN PRODUCT:
Use the exact perfume bottle from the reference image:
../../../../../references/bottles/male/bottle-black-cap.png

PRODUCT RULES:
The perfume bottle is the main protagonist and must remain fully visible.
Preserve: exact bottle design, shape, proportions, cap, label, material, overall product identity.
Must not be covered: true.
Must not be distorted: true.
Must not be duplicated: true.

SCENE:
La botella suspendida dentro de una corriente orgánica de oud, patchouli e higo: una estructura botánica irregular atraviesa el espacio, mientras la bergamota aporta destellos luminosos y el azafrán activa una energía cálida alrededor del frasco.

ENVIRONMENT:
Un espacio oscuro y tridimensional de aire ámbar, madera resinosa y hojas húmedas. La botella flota cerca del centro visual sobre el eje principal, completamente enfocada y con una inclinación fija de aproximadamente 8 grados: el tapón queda ligeramente desplazado hacia la izquierda y la base hacia la derecha. Masas de ingredientes se acercan a ambos laterales y continúan detrás de la silueta sin cubrir ninguna parte del producto.

COMPOSITION AND SPATIAL PLAN:
Style: rich compact asymmetrical enveloping composition built from organic wood, botanical clusters and atmospheric continuity
Element density: high locally clustered with clear hierarchy; substantial masses near the bottle and smaller accents only where they reinforce depth
Depth: physically coherent foreground, midground and background; extreme product focus with medium-shallow falloff on nearby ingredients
Bottle priority: highest; fully visible and recognizable through a dark clean silhouette, controlled rim light, label contrast and sharp focus
Negative space: small irregular breathing areas between material masses; no wide empty halo around the bottle
Enveloping structure: An irregular resinous oud-wood structure begins as a cropped low-right foreground mass, rises behind the bottle in naturally curved split branches and recedes toward the upper-left background. Patchouli stems and leaves bind into the wood, while fig leaves and saffron threads weave through the structure. The continuity is physical and botanical, not a liquid ribbon or geometric enclosure.
Primary clusters: Cluster 1, dominant right side: a dense group of three to four realistic figs, broad patchouli leaves and a few rose blooms close to the bottle's lower-right and mid-right side; it has the greatest organic volume, with front figs cropped by the frame and rear leaves passing behind the bottle silhouette without touching the label.; Cluster 2, lighter left side: several bergamotas whole and cut, two compact roses and sparse saffron flowers positioned close to the bottle's upper-left and lower-left; this cluster is smaller and more luminous, connected to the right cluster by curved oud fragments and drifting saffron threads.; Cluster 3, structural lower background: a heavier bed of dark oud wood pieces and patchouli stems running from the lower-right foreground behind the bottle toward the far-left background; it supplies depth and unequal visual weight rather than forming a symmetrical frame.
Foreground plan: Place a few bergamotas cut at realistic scale very close to the lower-left lens, partially cropped and softly defocused; add overlapping patchouli leaves and a dark oud fragment entering from the lower-right edge. Include one cropped fig and a few rose petals near the bottom margin, all materially integrated with the air and wood rather than floating as isolated objects.
Midground plan: Keep the bottle near the visual centre and in sharp focus. Concentrate the main fig-patchouli mass beside the lower-right silhouette and the bergamot-rose-saffron group beside the upper-left silhouette. Place curved oud branches and stems behind the bottle, close enough to create enclosure but leave the entire cap, glass body and label unobstructed through tonal contrast and focus.
Background plan: Continue the oud branches, patchouli stems and intermittent fig leaves behind the bottle into a dark amber atmospheric background and toward all image edges. Recede the rear clusters through softened focus, mineral haze and warm rim light; maintain material density behind the product so the environment never becomes an empty void.
Overlap plan: Patchouli leaves overlap the bases of figs and partially overlap oud fragments in the foreground. Rose stems pass behind the bottle's left side, while oud branches pass behind both lateral edges without crossing the label. Bergamot pieces overlap a few saffron flowers in the lower-left cluster. All overlaps remain outside the bottle contour, cap and label; no ingredient covers or intersects the product.
Negative space plan: Use narrow irregular openings between the bergamot cluster and the left bottle edge, between the fig leaves and the right shoulder, and in small pockets within the oud structure. Keep these spaces organic and uneven, filled with faint amber haze; never create a circular clearing or wide empty halo around the bottle.

MOVEMENT:
Enabled: true
Types: floating, suspended, swirling
Intensity: controlled

SELECTED OLFACTIVE NOTES — SURREAL TREATMENT:
Note: Bergamota
Olfactive role: Luminous citrus opening and energetic freshness.
Visual representation: Several realistically sized bergamot fruits, some whole and some cut, showing textured green-gold rind and pale translucent pulp.
Quantity: several
Physical presence: medium, luminous supporting presence
Composition role: Creates the bright entry point and balances the warm, dark materials.
Selection reason: It communicates the fragrance's bright opening and provides a crisp visual counterpoint to the dark woody base.
Surreal use: A compact asymmetrical citrus cluster enters from the lower-left foreground and continues behind the bottle at different depths; a few suspended cut segments act only as restrained accents.

Note: Higo
Olfactive role: Sweet, creamy, green-fruity heart.
Visual representation: Multiple small figs, whole and naturally split, with muted violet skin, granular ruby interiors and broad matte green leaves.
Quantity: abundant
Physical presence: high, major secondary protagonist
Composition role: Provides the main organic mass, tactile richness and soft fruity volume.
Selection reason: Fig is one of the most distinctive tactile elements in the description, linking sweetness, softness and sensuality.
Surreal use: The principal right-side cluster is built from figs and leaves close to the bottle, with foreground figs partially cropped and softly defocused; the cluster extends behind the product without covering it.

Note: Rosa
Olfactive role: Elegant floral sensuality.
Visual representation: Several natural dusty-rose blooms and partially opened petals, realistic in scale, with visible layered petal texture.
Quantity: moderate
Physical presence: medium-high, refined floral presence
Composition role: Introduces elegance, softness and a controlled organic vertical rhythm.
Selection reason: Rose gives the composition its refined floral identity and prevents the spicy woods from becoming visually severe.
Surreal use: A dense rose-and-petal cluster occupies the upper-left midground, with stems curving naturally behind the bottle and petals drifting subtly through the depth without forming a geometric ring.

Note: azafran
Olfactive role: Exotic warm spice and luxurious intensity.
Visual representation: Small natural saffron crocus flowers and delicate red saffron threads gathered in a shallow dark ceramic vessel and scattered sparingly.
Quantity: moderate
Physical presence: high in detail, low in bulk
Composition role: Adds preciousness, fine linear texture and a warm red-gold chromatic spark.
Selection reason: Saffron is the clearest visual expression of the perfume's spicy, exclusive and luxurious character.
Surreal use: Thin saffron threads and a few flowers are integrated into the connecting material structure between the fig and oud clusters, with restrained suspended movement and no clutter.

Note: madera de oud
Olfactive role: Deep woody luxury and mystery.
Visual representation: Several realistic dark oud wood fragments, slim split pieces and textured chips, with resinous black-brown grain and subtle polished highlights.
Quantity: abundant
Physical presence: high, structural secondary protagonist
Composition role: Builds the enveloping material framework, depth and dark contrast around the bottle.
Selection reason: Oud anchors the fragrance's sophisticated, intense base and gives the visual story its architectural weight.
Surreal use: A dominant organic wood structure arcs irregularly from the lower-right foreground behind the bottle toward the upper background, creating continuity between clusters without becoming a ring or artificial ribbon.

Note: patchouli
Olfactive role: Earthy green depth and lasting base.
Visual representation: Generous clusters of real patchouli leaves in varied states, including whole matte leaves, layered stems and a few dried curled leaves.
Quantity: abundant
Physical presence: medium-high, connective environmental presence
Composition role: Connects all selected ingredients through green texture, organic layering and earthy atmosphere.
Selection reason: Patchouli adds the earthy-green dimension needed to connect the citrus, floral and woody elements into one natural environment.
Surreal use: Patchouli leaves form irregular breathing boundaries around the lower and lateral clusters, some very close to camera and softly blurred, others extending into the atmospheric background.

VISUAL ELEMENTS:
botella suspendida con inclinación fija de 8 grados hacia la izquierda en la parte superior, ramas y fragmentos curvos de madera de oud, masas compactas de higos y hojas, rosas y pétalos en profundidad, hebras y flores de azafrán, bergamotas enteras y cortadas en primer plano, hojas de patchouli en varios planos, niebla mineral ámbar y partículas sutiles

deep charcoal brown, blackened oud, dark olive, fig violet, dusty rose, bergamot green-gold, saffron red-orange, warm amber

MATERIALS:
resinous dark oud wood, fresh matte patchouli leaves, velvety figs, dusty rose petals, textured bergamot rind, fine saffron threads, mineral amber haze, transparent perfume glass

LIGHTING:
strong soft key from upper-left/front, warm rim light from upper-right behind the bottle and subtle low amber bounce from below.
Contrast: high enough to separate the bottle and label from the ingredient masses, with controlled luminous highlights on glass, citrus rind and saffron.

- Build a physically coherent foreground, midground and background.
